FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 467
Committee: Ways and Means - Education Sponsor: Representative Anthony Daniels
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/15/2023
House Bill 467as introduced would allow for up to $25 million dollars to be appropriated to the State
Small Business Credit Initiative (SSBCI) Alabama Rural, Agribusiness, and Opportunity Zone Jobs Act
Account. Pursuant to the provisions of this bill, this bill would only become operative if the Legislature
appropriates $12.5 million or more to the SSBCI Alabama Rural, Agribusiness, and Opportunity Zone
Jobs Act Account for the fiscal year 2023-2024.
